missing: A direct, tested comparison of every 4-bay NAS with built-in 10GbE under $700 (DXP4800 Plus, DXP4800 GT, F4-424 Max, DXP4800 Pro on sale), with measured 10GbE throughput, current non-sale prices and a clear pick.
why: No major reviewer or authority answers this question with its own testing. Android Central's page is a deal post on one model (the DXP4800 Pro) at a sale price. Two small spec and price-tracking sites (terabytewise and kuibu) partly answer it. Neither shows testing, and neither directly compares all the 4-bay 10GbE models under $700. The rest are Newegg listings, a maker's blog about a different budget, and general NAS guides. A focused page with current prices and a direct pick would stand out.
